title: API error envelope
description: A stable `error` code with a human-readable `message`. A 4xx names the refusal. A 5xx that the service did not classify answers the fixed code `internal_error` with a fixed message and a `request_id` to quote to support; the failure's own text goes to the error report, and the log line names the exception class and that same `request_id`. Status code comes from exc.status_code (default 500).

request_id.description: Correlation id for one failed request. Present on an unclassified 5xx.
